text: The International Preparatory Program of Beijing Institute of Technology is an undergraduate preparatory education for international students at Beijing Institute of Technology. The purpose is to help international students meet the undergraduate admission requirements of Beijing Institute of Technology through 1-2 semesters of language and basic subject study and consolidation. The main courses include Chinese language, mathematics, physics, Chinese cultural inheritance and scientific and technological innovation, cross-cultural communication and team management, etc. At the same time, students will be provided with HSK pre-exam training. Students who participate in this program and pass the assessment can directly enter the undergraduate program of our university.The Foundation course consists of two different programs:Program A (Offline program) : Applicants are international students with HSK4 level or equivalent Chinese language level, and have reached the undergraduate admission standard through one semester of Chinese language, mathematics, physics and other courses.Program B (Offline program) : Applicants are international students with HSK-3 level or equivalent Chinese language level, and have reached the undergraduate admission standard through one academic year of Chinese, mathematics, physics and other courses.
